nodeGroups.name: Run full pipeline
nodeGroups.description: One call runs segment then extract then analyze-gaps then score on a fresh session and returns the final AuditState; reports the failing stage if

nodeGroups.name: Health check
nodeGroups.description: Liveness probe: replies {"status":"ok"} to GET /health.

nodeGroups.name: Create session
nodeGroups.description: Mints a uuid, stores an empty AuditState row, and returns the new session_id.

nodeGroups.name: Get session
nodeGroups.description: Looks up the session by id and returns its AuditState, or 404 if unknown.

nodeGroups.name: Gemini ping
nodeGroups.description: Verifies the session exists, then calls Gemini with a trivial prompt to prove the integration.

nodeGroups.name: Segment documents
nodeGroups.description: Splits rfp_text and draft_text into character-mapped Segments and stores them on the session.

nodeGroups.name: Extract requirements
nodeGroups.description: Sends RFP segments to Gemini, validates the structured requirement list, and saves it to the session.

nodeGroups.name: Analyze gaps
nodeGroups.description: Maps every extracted requirement against the draft segments via Gemini, validates and cites the matrix, and saves it to the session.

nodeGroups.name: Score proposal
nodeGroups.description: Derives completeness and risk from the compliance matrix, scores the other 5 criteria in one Gemini call, applies weights, and saves the scorecar

nodeGroups.name: Rescore weights
nodeGroups.description: Recomputes the overall score from already-stored criterion scores using new weights — pure arithmetic, no LLM call, for the live weight slider.

nodeGroups.name: Generate rewrites
nodeGroups.description: For weak/missing requirements only, asks Gemini for copy-pasteable replacement or insertion text (no fabricated numbers), and saves the rewrite s
